01.09.2023 WPSB No. 579 of 2017 
WPSB No. 451 of 2016 (Decided Writ Petition) 
WPSB No. 130 of 2017

WPSB No. 268 of 2023 
Sri Vipin Sanghi, C.J.
Sri Alok Kumar Verma, J.
1. Mr A.S. Rawat, learned Senior Counsel assisted 
by Mr. Dharmendra Barthwal, learned counsel for the 
Uttarakhand Power Corporation Ltd. 
2. Mr. M.C. Pant, learned counsel for the petitioner 
in WPSB No.543 of 2017. 
3. Mr. Abhijay Negi, learned counsel for the 
petitioner in WPSB No.550 of 2017. 
4. Mr. Abhishek Singh and Ms. Priyanka Agarwal, 
learned counsels for the petitioner in WPSB No.554 of 
2017. 
5. Mr. Piyush Garg, learned counsel for the 
petitioner in WPSB No.563 of 2017. 
6. Mr. Rajendra Dobhal, learned Senior Counsel 
assisted by Mr. I.P. Gairola, Mr. Shobhit Saharia, Mr. 
Vinay Kumar, Mr. Bhupesh Kandpal and Mr. Shashank 
Pandey, learned counsels for the private respondents. 
7. The Registry has reported that respondent no.18 
has not been served. 
8. Mr. Barthwal, who appears for the UPCL, states 
that respondent no.18- Mr. Jakir Hussain, has died. 
9. That being the position, we delete respondent 
no.18 from the array of the respondents. The interest 
of the heirs of respondent no.18 is sufficiently 
protected, inasmuch, as his cause is the same as that 
of the other private respondents, who are contesting  these proceedings. 
10. In the light of the aforesaid, service on the 
respondents is complete. 
11. It appears to us that the only solution would be 
to hear the writ petitions finally, as there is serious 
controversy whether the petitioner- UPCL, has 
complied with our order dated 09.06.2023, or not. 
12. Accordingly, list the petitions for hearing on 
06.10.2023 before a Bench comprising of Hon’ble Mr. 
Justice Ravindra Maithani and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Alok 
Kumar Verma.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) (Vipin Sanghi, C.J.) 
 01.09.2023 01.09.2023 
NISHANT
